title: Lena and the Songbook
author: P. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Mara Winterbourne, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
